summary: binary assets: ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug>|--research] [--extract] | extract <slug> | distill <slug> | link <file> <hub> | list | open <slug>
usage: ops files ingest [<path>] [--client|--project|--area <slug> | --research] [--extract] | extract <slug> [--reextract] [--heavy] [--lang <x>] [--diarize] [--describe] | distill <slug> | link <file> <hub> | list [--hub <slug>] | open <slug>
hints: The binary-assets plane: ingest routes a file into ~/files + writes a wiki shadow note; extract emits a SIBLING derived note wiki/files/<slug>.extract.md (type extract|transcript, derived_from/source_sha256/tool) from the source bytes via auto-detected optional deps (txt/md with stdlib). distill compiles that extract into 1-N author:agent/status:draft concept notes in wiki/notes/ (typed JSON payload with an agent, heading-outline fallback without; promote via `ops triage drafts`). Same-bytes+same-tool re-run is a no-op; --reextract forces. Common mistake: expecting the binary in git — only the plaintext shadow + extract notes are tracked; and expecting a transcript without the tier's dep installed (it degrades with an install hint).
